mood: Warm, optimistic, energetic, trusted elder sibling (Didi) vibe. Not a government portal, but a modern Indian D2C/startup platform. Stripe's clarity + Notion's warmth.

headings.strategy: Large, confident, tight tracking. Mixed Hindi-Latin text must look balanced and dignified.

body.strategy: Clean, highly readable on mobile, relaxed line height.

primary.name: Amber/Saffron Accent
primary.description: Used for main CTAs, highlights, and energetic accents. Represents optimism and action.

background.description: Main background is a warm cream/off-white, not stark white. Cards are pure white for contrast.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows for depth without harshness. E.g., `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]`.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin, warm-tinted borders `border-[#EA580C]/15` to define cards against the cream background.
visual_enhancers.radii: Generous rounded corners. Cards: `rounded-2xl` or `rounded-3xl`. Chips: `rounded-full`.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the sticky top navigation and mobile bottom CTA bar (`bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md`).
visual_enhancers.blobs: Subtle, blurred, organic SVG blobs in the background using the primary amber color at very low opacity (5-10%) to break up solid backgrounds.

layouts.spacing: Generous padding. Use `py-20` to `py-32` for sections on desktop, `py-16` on mobile.
layouts.grid: Bento-style grids for 'What You Get' section. Asymmetric layouts to avoid the 'government form' look.
layouts.mobile_first: Ensure all interactive elements have large tap targets. A sticky CTA at the bottom of the screen on mobile is REQUIRED after the hero section.

motion.scroll_animations: Use `framer-motion` for subtle fade-up and slide-up animations on section entry.
motion.hero: Floating phone mockup using a slow, repeating vertical translation (`y: [0, -10, 0]`) in framer-motion.
motion.counters: Animated number counters using `framer-motion` when scrolled into view.
motion.ticker: Continuous auto-scrolling marquee for the Live Dashboard using `react-fast-marquee` or pure CSS animation.
motion.hover: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-1`) with enhanced shadow. Buttons scale slightly (`scale-105`).

components_strategy.marketing_sections: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for expressive layout, overlapping elements, and specific spacings.
components_strategy.interactive_elements: Use Shadcn components for complex logic (e.g., Select, Form) but strip any default Vercel/monochrome look. Re-style them with rounded corners, warm borders, and amber focus rings (`focus:ring-orange-500`).
components_strategy.chips: Pill-shaped toggles/labels (`rounded-full px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-orange-100 text-gray-700 hover:border-orange-500 transition-colors`). Used heavily in the form and stats.
components_strategy.charts: Use Recharts for the age-group breakdown in the Live Dashboard. Style it with warm amber/orange tones.
components_strategy.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Ensure stroke width is consistent (typically 1.5 or 2).

specific_section_instructions.nav: Sticky glass header. Logo left, anchor links center (hidden on mobile), 'Apna Idea Submit Karein' CTA right.
specific_section_instructions.hero: Headline: 'Har business ek idea se shuru hota hai.' CTA 'Apna Idea Submit Karein' & 'Explore ShuruKar' ghost button. Right side: Floating phone mockup showing a chat UI with Hindi bubbles. Trust strip below.
specific_section_instructions.why_shurukar: 2-col layout. Left: Headline & Pull-quote. Right: Icon list of 5 questions. Tagline: 'Sapna aapka. Safar humara saath.'
specific_section_instructions.stats_row: 4 Stat chips (24x7, 7 din, Aapki Bhasha, Free) in a flex row, wrapping on mobile.
specific_section_instructions.what_you_get: 5 feature cards in a Bento grid. Close with a full-width dark section with the statement: 'Yeh sirf app nahi hai. Yeh Bharat ka entrepreneurship movement hai.'
specific_section_instructions.founder_movement: Editorial photo mask (organic shape). Pull-quote. Horizontally scrollable city chips.
specific_section_instructions.bharat_project_safar: 4 animated stat counters + vertical or horizontal mini-timeline with glowing 'You are here' indicator for 'ShuruKar AI Co-Pilot'.
specific_section_instructions.live_dashboard: Cards row with animated counters (Total Ideas, Cities, Today). Age-group Rechart (bar or donut). Auto-scrolling ticker of recent submissions.
specific_section_instructions.submission_form: Startup onboarding style card. Fields: Name, Mobile, Email, City, Age Group (Chips), Idea (Textarea with rotating placeholder), Stage (Chips). Success state replaces form with confetti and share buttons.

ambient_gradients.description: Warm orange/red gradient for abstract background blobs.
Bright orange to dark red gradient for hero or dark section accents.

founder_placeholder.description: Confident entrepreneur portrait (to be replaced with actual Shradha Sharma photo later).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure amber text on cream background passes WCAG AA. Use #C2410C for text, #EA580C for large buttons.
accessibility.interactive: Include `data-testid` on all buttons, form inputs, and key sections.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on form fields, tinted orange.

instructions_to_main_agent: Start by setting up the Tailwind configuration with the custom colors (#EA580C, #14213D, #FEF9F3) and fonts (Poppins, Inter).
Apply `bg-[#FEF9F3]` to the main body to ensure the warm cream background is consistent.
Build the page as a single, scrolling landing page (`App.js`) divided into semantic `<section>` blocks with IDs for anchor scrolling.
Implement the 'Mobile Bottom Sticky CTA'. It should appear only on mobile breakpoints (`md:hidden`) and stick to the bottom of the viewport using `fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50`.
For the Hero section, construct a CSS/Tailwind-based 'phone mockup' (a rounded-3xl div with a border and shadow) containing a mockup chat UI with Hindi text bubbles.
For the Submission Form, use an interactive state `isSubmitted` to swap the form view with the success/confetti view.
Ensure the Hindi text is visually prominent and elegantly mixed with English (Hinglish). Use Poppins for these headings.
Use `framer-motion` to wrap sections in `<motion.div>` for `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` and `whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the specified warm color palette and bold typography.
Do not center-align paragraphs; keep them left-aligned for natural reading. Center alignment is only for hero titles or section headers.
Add transitions to buttons (e.g., `transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-lg`). Do not use `transition: all` globally.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all actionable items and major sections.
Use pill-shaped buttons (`rounded-full`) for CTAs to match the D2C startup vibe.
Incorporate generous spacing (`py-24` desktop, `py-16` mobile) between sections.
